title: Allopurinol in the long-term management of gout
text: Allopurinol lowers serum uric acid concentrations by inhibiting xanthine oxidase, the enzyme responsible for uric acid production. It is used for long-term prophylaxis against recurrent gout flares rather than for treatment of an acute attack, and therapy is typically initiated after the acute inflammatory episode has resolved.
